extension.valueString: define "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period":  ( [Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union   [Encounter: "Emergency Department Visit"] union [Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"emergency", "inpatient acute", "inpatient encounter", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]) QualifyingEncounters   where QualifyingEncounters .status = 'finished'     and QualifyingEncounters.period ends during "Measurement Period"

define "Qualifying Location During Measurement Period":   [Encounter] Encounters     with Encounters.location EncounterLocation     such that Global.GetLocation(EncounterLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations"      and start of EncounterLocation.period during "Measurement Period"

/*  define "Encounter Location During Measurement Period":   [Encounter] Encounters     with Encounters.location EncounterLocation     such that exists(Encounters.location)     and EncounterLocation.period during "Measurement Period" */ define "Initial Population":   "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period"   union "Qualifying Location During Measurement Period"

define "SDE Body Weight Observation":   [Observation: "body weight"] O     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation      such that Global."Normalize Interval"(O.effective) during InitialPopulation.period       and O.status in {'final'}     with O.category category     such that category ~"vital-signs"
SDE Service Request Clostridioides difficile Infection Lab

/* do not want the generitic serviceRequest define "SDE Service Request": [ServiceRequest] CdiServiceRequestLab   with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that (CdiServiceRequestLab.intent ~ 'order'     and CdiServiceRequestLab.status ~ 'completed')     and CdiServiceRequestLab.authoredOn during InitialPopulation.period */ define "SDE Service Request Clostridioides difficile Infection Lab":  [ServiceRequest: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] CdiServiceRequestLab   with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that (CdiServiceRequestLab.intent ~ 'order'     and CdiServiceRequestLab.status ~ 'completed')     and CdiServiceRequestLab.authoredOn during InitialPopulation.period
define "SDE Encounter with Discharge Dispositions":  "Initial Population" DischargeDispositions    where DischargeDispositions.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition in "Discharge Disposition"

define "SDE EncounterDiagnosis Condition":   [Condition] ConditionEncounterDiagnosis     where true in HasCategoryEncounterDiagnosis(ConditionEncounterDiagnosis.category)     and exists("Initial Population")

define "SDE Laboratory Observation CDI Stool":   [Observation: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] CdiObservationLab     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation     such that Global."Normalize Interval"(CdiObservationLab.effective) during InitialPopulation.period       and CdiObservationLab.status ~ 'final'     with CdiObservationLab.category Category     such that Category ~ "laboratory"

define "SDE Observation CDI Stool":   [Observation: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] CdiObservationLab     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation     such that Global."Normalize Interval"(CdiObservationLab.effective) during InitialPopulation.period       and CdiObservationLab.status ~ 'final'
define "SDE Encounter with Discharge Diagnosis":   "Initial Population" EncounterDD     with EncounterDD.diagnosis diagnosis     such that diagnosis.use ~ "Discharge Diagnosis"

define "SDE Body Height Observation":   [Observation: "body height"] O     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation      such that Global."Normalize Interval"(O.effective) during InitialPopulation.period       and O.status in {'final'}     with O.category category     such that category ~"vital-signs"

//and MedicationAdministration.status in {'completed', 'in-progress'}  /* do not constrain to CDI medication define "SDE Medication Administration Fidaxomicin, Vancomycin, and Metronidazole": [MedicationAdministration] MedicationAdministrationWithCode   with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationAdministrationWithCode.effective) during InitialPopulation.period     and MedicationAdministrationWithCode.status in {'completed', 'in-progress'}     and GetMedicationCode(MedicationAdministrationWithCode.medication) in "Fidaxomicin, Vancomycin, and Metronidazole"  */ define "SDE Payer":   SDE."SDE Payer" Payer   with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that start of Payer.period before end of InitialPopulation.period
define "SDE CDC Locations":  [Location: type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations"] CDCLationLocation    where exists("Initial Population")
define "SDE Minimal Patient":   Patient p   return PatientResource(p)
define "SDE Specimen":   [Specimen] Specimen     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation     such that Global."Normalize Interval"(Specimen.collection.collected) during InitialPopulation.period

define "SDE Medication Request":   [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequest     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation      such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationRequest.authoredOn) during InitialPopulation.period

//============================ //Supplemental Data Element //============================ define "SDE Encounter Locations":  "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   with InitialPopulation.location IntialPopulationLocation   such that ((Global.GetLocation(IntialPopulationLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations"     or Global.GetLocation(IntialPopulationLocation.location).physicalType in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations")     and IntialPopulationLocation.period during "Measurement Period")
SDE Laboratory Observation CDI Stool with Specimen

define "SDE Laboratory Observation CDI Stool with Specimen":   "SDE Laboratory Observation CDI Stool" CdiObservationLab     let ReferenceToSpecimen: GetSpecimen(CdiObservationLab.specimen)     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation      such that Global."Normalize Interval"(ReferenceToSpecimen.collection.collected) during InitialPopulation.period

define "SDE Laboratory Observation CDI Stool 1":   [Observation: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] Observations     where (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "laboratory"))     and Global."Normalize Interval"(Observations.effective) during "Measurement Period"     and Observations.status ~ 'final'

//and MedicationRequest.status in {'active', 'completed'}  /* do not want to constrain the medication to CDI medication  define "SDE Medication Request Fidaxomicin Vancomycin Metronidazole": [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequestWithCode    with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation    such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationRequestWithCode.authoredOn) during InitialPopulation.period     and MedicationRequestWithCode.status in {'active', 'completed'}     and GetMedicationCode(MedicationRequestWithCode.medication) in "Fidaxomicin, Vancomycin, and Metronidazole"  */ define "SDE Medication Administration": [MedicationAdministration] MedicationAdministration   with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that Global."Normalize Interval"(MedicationAdministration.effective) during InitialPopulation.period

define "SDE Observation with CDI Specimen":   [Observation: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] ObservationWithSpecimen     let ReferenceToSpecimen: GetSpecimen(ObservationWithSpecimen.specimen)     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation      such that Global."Normalize Interval"(ReferenceToSpecimen.collection.collected) during InitialPopulation.period

define "SDE Diagnostic Report Stool":   [DiagnosticReport: "Lab Tests for Clostridioides difficile Infection"] CdiDiagnosticReportLab     with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation     such that Global."Normalize Interval"(CdiDiagnosticReportLab.effective) during InitialPopulation.period       and CdiDiagnosticReportLab.status in {'final'}

define "SDE Condition":   [Condition] Conditions    with "Initial Population" InitialPopulation   such that Global."Normalize Interval"(Conditions.onset) overlaps InitialPopulation.period   and Conditions.clinicalStatus ~ Global."active"
define "SDE Location":   [Location] Location   where exists("Initial Population")

define "SDE Encounter with Admit Source":   "Initial Population" EncounterAdmitSource   where EncounterAdmitSource.hospitalization.admitSource in "Admit Source"

resource.name: NHSNAntibioticTreatedCDIInitialPopulation
resource.title: Measure NHSN Antibiotic Treated CDI Initial Population
resource.description: Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile) is responsible for a spectrum of C. difficile infections (CDI), including uncomplicated diarrhea, pseudomembranous colitis, and toxic megacolon, which can, in some instances, lead to sepsis and even death. As outlined in the Healthcare Infection Control Practices Advisory Committee (HICPAC) guideline (1), C. difficile pathogens may require specialized monitoring to evaluate if intensified infection control efforts are required to reduce the occurrence of these organisms and related infections.  The goal of this module is to provide a mechanism for facilities to report and to analyze data that will inform infection prevention professionals of the impact of targeted prevention efforts. This protocol describes the electronic surveillance for Antibiotic-treated Healthcare Facility-onset CDI.
resource.rationale: The Antibiotic-treated CDI Event Module provides a mechanism for facilities to report and to analyze CDI events based on a combination of C. difficile positive laboratory results and therapeutic treatment, and to receive analytic reports based on these data to inform targeted healthcare-associated (HAI) prevention efforts and facility benchmarking. The IP dQM provides the initial population and FHIR line-level data necessary for calculating the module metrics.
definition: Inpatient admission: For NHSN reporting purposes, the date admitted to the facility is hospital day one. NHSN defines an inpatient as any patient cared for or housed on an inpatient location. Local status may differ from NHSN definition. All days spent in an inpatient unit, regardless of local admission status and/or billing status are included in the counts of admissions and inpatient days. For NHSN reporting purposes, the date admitted to the facility is the calendar date that the patient physically locates to an inpatient location.
ED/Observation encounter: Any patient visits to an ED or Observation location. One patient visiting equals one encounter. ED/Observation are considered outpatient locations.
Finalized encounter or admission: Discharged patients with finalized complete medical billing coding.
HOT-CDI:  Healthcare Facility-Onset Antibiotic-Treated C. difficile Infection Event
COT-CDI: Community-Onset Antibiotic-Treated C. difficile Infection Event
Outpatient CO-CDI: Outpatient Community-Onset C. difficile Infection Event

Qualifying C. difficile assays:   Qualifying C. difficile assays within the CDI Event Module include:       1. Positive laboratory test result for C. difficile toxin A and/or toxin B, OR      2. Any detection of toxin-producing C. difficile organisms by culture or other laboratory means on an unformed stool specimen that conforms to the container.   Testing methods include, but are not limited to:      1. Molecular assays (e.g., PCR, NAAT)      2. Toxin assays (e.g., EIA)

Qualifying Antimicrobial Therapy (QAT):  Qualifying Antimicrobial Therapy within the CDI Event includes administration of a new therapeutic agent for the indicated treatment duration within the appropriate window period the C. difficile positive testing result according to the following criteria: 1. The therapeutic agent is considered new for the purposes of this definition if it was not given to the patient on either of the 2 calendar days preceding the current start date.  2. Therapeutic agents for CDI are defined as follows: a. Enteral* vancomycin  b. Enteral* metronidazole c. Intravenous (IV) metronidazole d. Enteral* fidaxomicin *Enteral routes include any route that allows absorption via the gastrointestinal tract, and as examples include oral (PO), rectal (PR), and administration via nasogastric (NG), orogastric (OG), gastrostomy (G-tube), and gastrojejunostomy tube (G-J tube). Note: bezlotoxumab is not included as it is utilized primarily in outpatient settings.       3. Treatment Duration: A patient must have had at least 5 consecutive calendar days of appropriate    antimicrobials to meet QAT criteria. Furthermore: o If a patient is discharged, dies, transitions to hospice care, or is transferred to another facility before 5 QATs are met, then the QAT requirement is still met as long as the QATs are on consecutive days until the day of, or 1 calendar day prior to the discharge, death, transition to hospice care, or transfer to another facility. o Treatment will be considered consecutive if the therapeutic agents are administered daily with a gap of up to 1 calendar day       4. Window Period: The date the C. difficile positive stool specimen is collected is the center of a window period extending both 2 calendar days before and 2 calendar days after the stool specimen.  o The start date of at least one therapeutic agent must fall within the window period. The therapeutic agent or route of administration of agent can be changed as long as the start date of at least one therapeutic agent falls within the window period. o Therapeutic agents with start dates prior to the window period will not count toward QAT.
